players.product: Ultra-high-purity colloidal silica for semiconductor CMP slurries

quarterly_data.quarter: Fuso Chemical semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-07-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: First half, April - September 2025 (semi-annual report): net sales JPY 37,705 million (+8.5% YoY), operating profit JPY 9,746 million (+19.7%), ordinary profit JPY 9,807 million (+23.4%). Electronic Materials and Functional Chemicals segment: sales JPY 19,922 million (+23.8%), operating profit JPY 8,425 million (+29.3%) - management states semiconductor demand stayed firm, centred on AI, and ultra-high-purity colloidal silica volumes rose, offsetting a stronger yen and higher depreciation and start-up costs of the new Kyoto plant. Life Science segment: sales JPY 17,783 million (-4.7%), operating profit JPY 2,516 million (-8.2%). R&D expenses JPY 512 million.
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 37,705 million (+8.5%); Electronic Materials sales JPY 19,922 million (+23.8%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Fuso Chemical semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-07-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Kashima site ultra-high-purity colloidal silica plant and ancillary facilities: total planned investment JPY 20,000 million, JPY 17,457 million paid, construction started September 2023 and completed August 2025; full-scale operation was scheduled for December 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: JPY 20,000 million plant; completed August 2025, full operation scheduled December 2025
